verdict.rationale: Alloy documents real-time decisioning on events, including interdicting on transactions. Events mapped to a Source Workflow return their results in an evaluations[] array, and evaluations include a services object showing each vendor service's execution status. Transaction-monitoring workflows can also generate alerts or investigations. Missing for 10: documented display of the supporting matches behind a decision (e.g., watchlist or sanctions hits), an explicit hold-before-release payment flow, a compliance-officer dashboard view for inspecting decisions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
